source.note: Preliminary-design guide; PDF pp10-12 permits project/mould changes. One dimensioned model, not an exhaustive standard-size family. LIITE 3.1 is material consumption curves, not a size matrix.

TIEL-model-AA-h1270.scope: Nominal bare concrete A-A only; no CIP slab, reinforcement, end blocks or undocumented chamfers.
